methodology: Rank within separately reported ISO-country categories after excluding domestic origin, aggregate categories and missing/nonpositive cells. No named country is reconstructed from a regional aggregate. Count and flag are preserved from each selected JSON-stat cell. Lists can contain fewer than 20 countries when coverage is narrower.

BE.label: Historical annual top 20 individually reported country markets
BE.note: Inbound counts arrivals at hotels, holiday/short-stay accommodation and camping establishments, not border tourist arrivals or unique people. Outbound counts overnight trips of residents aged 15 and over for all personal and business purposes. These are the largest available individually named foreign-country categories, not an exhaustive worldwide ranking: regional/other-country aggregates and the combined Switzerland/Liechtenstein group are excluded. A country hidden inside an aggregate may be missing even if important. Missing values are not zero travel. Annual 2024 evidence is not a November/December 2026 forecast.
BE.inboundDefinition: Accommodation arrivals by guest country of residence, NACE I551–I553; number of establishment arrivals
BE.outboundDefinition: Resident tourism trips of at least one overnight stay, population aged 15+, all purposes; number of trips
BE.inboundScope: Top available individually reported foreign-country categories; combined and regional aggregates excluded
BE.outboundScope: Top available individually reported foreign-country categories; regional aggregates excluded

MK.note: Inbound counts arrivals at hotels, holiday/short-stay accommodation and camping establishments, not border tourist arrivals or unique people. Outbound counts overnight trips of residents aged 15 and over for all personal and business purposes. These are the largest available individually named foreign-country categories, not an exhaustive worldwide ranking: regional/other-country aggregates and the combined Switzerland/Liechtenstein group are excluded. A country hidden inside an aggregate may be missing even if important. Missing values are not zero travel. Annual 2024 evidence is not a November/December 2026 forecast.
MK.inboundDefinition: Accommodation arrivals by guest country of residence, NACE I551–I553; number of establishment arrivals
MK.outboundDefinition: Resident tourism trips of at least one overnight stay, population aged 15+, all purposes; number of trips
MK.inboundScope: Top available individually reported foreign-country categories; combined and regional aggregates excluded
MK.outboundScope: Top available individually reported foreign-country categories; regional aggregates excluded
